• Long handle reaches the bottom of water bottles, tall glasses and tumblers
• Soft silicone bristles all around the head, gentle on glass
• Hang it up to dry by the loop on the handle

records.caption:
Tired of blank walls? Turn your room into an enchanted forest tonight

Bare walls make even a beautiful bedroom feel unfinished, and paint isn't an option when you rent. This navy and gold woodland wallpaper, full of trees, moons, stars, birds, rabbits and foxes, peels on and off, so you can bring storybook magic to a wall in an afternoon. A moody sanctuary you'll be proud to show off.

• Full roll 17.7 x 118 in (45 x 300 cm), about 14.5 sq ft; 12 x 12 in sample also available
• Removable vinyl, peel and stick, squeegee included
• Peel a corner, stick from the top down, smooth out with the squeegee

Link in the first comment. From $14.99 (sample), full roll $26.99, free shipping.

Tired of a bedroom that feels like a hotel room nobody loves?

Plain curtains leave a room feeling flat, no matter how much you spend on furniture. These emerald green and gold Art Deco fan-pattern curtains bring instant 1920s glamour to a living room or bedroom window, and the blackout fabric keeps out the light when you want to sleep. Pull them shut at night and your room feels like a private speakeasy.

• Set of 2 panels, 50 x 84 in or 52 x 84 in each
• Three-layer woven blackout polyester
• Silver grommet top (1.6 in / 4 cm rings) slides onto a standard rod

Link in the first comment. From $69.99 for a set of 2 panels, free shipping.

records.caption:
Streetlight sneaking in around your curtains at night?

Thin curtains let in streetlights and early sun. These Art Deco curtains are three-layer woven blackout fabric, in a bold emerald green and gold geometric fan print that turns a plain window into the statement of the room. Silver grommets slide straight onto your rod.

• Set of 2 panels, 50 x 84 in or 52 x 84 in each
• Three-layer woven blackout polyester
• Silver grommet top (1.6 in / 4 cm rings) slides onto a standard rod

Shop it here: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4579548055/art-deco-curtains-emerald-gold-geometric?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=art_deco_curtains&utm_content=hookB
From $69.99 for a set of 2 panels, free shipping. Tap the link to see sizes and details.
